High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Counsel for Respondent :- Abhinava Krishna Srivastava,Anand Prakash Paul,C.S.C.
Hon'ble Manoj Kumar Gupta,J.
Hon'ble Manish Kumar Nigam,J.

1. Heard learned counsel for the petitioners, Shri Rajiv Gupta, learned Additional Chief Standing Counsel for the State-respondent and Shri Abhinav Krishna Srivastava, learned counsel for respondent No.3.
2.
The grievance of the petitioners is in relation to non-payment of enhanced compensation amount in terms of an award u/s 28A of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894.

On 23.5.2024, the following order was passed by this Court :-
Kallu And 17 Others vs State Of U.P. And 2 Others on 8 July, 2024

entities.text: Kallu And 17 Others vs State Of U.P. And 2 Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
It seems that in pursuance of order dated 31.10.2023 passed in previous writ petition of the petitioners being No.60366 of 2013, the Additional District Magistrate (Land Acquisition), Kanpur Nagar has sent a communication to the Secretary,
Kanpur Development Authority, Kanpur on 20.03.2024 for making available requisite funds for payment of compensation amount to the petitioners and other persons on basis of award made under Section 28-A of Land Acquisition Act, 1894.
2.

entities.text: Additional District Magistrate (Land Acquisition), Kanpur Nagar
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: The grievance of the petitioners is that the amount has not been released in favour of the petitioners so far.

3. Having regard to the submissions made, we direct respondent no.3 to ensure allocation of necessary funds and its transmission to the Special Land Acquisition Officer for payment to the persons entitled thereto in terms of the award passed under Section 28-A of Land Acquisition Act, 1894 by the next date, failing which, the Chairman of Kanpur Development Authority will join the proceedings of next date through video conferencing or remain present in person with explanation for the default.
4.
5. Sri Abhinav Krishna Srivastava, learned counsel for Kanpur Development Authority, Kanpur undertakes to communicate the instant order to the concerned official for due compliance.

6. When the matter is listed next, the name of Sri Abhinav Krishna Srivastava shall be shown as counsel for respondent no.3. "
3.

On matter being taken up today, an affidavit has been filed on behalf of the Kanpur Development Authority, Kanpur in which it has been stated that requisite fund for payment of enhanced compensation to the petitioners has been made available to the Additional District Magistrate,
Kanpur Nagar vide Cheque dated 28.6.2024.
A communication sent in this behalf to him has been brought on record along with the affidavit.

4. In view of the aforesaid development, we dispose of the instant petition with the direction to respondent No.2 to further proceed in the matter by doing needful, in accordance with law, within a week.

Order Date :- 8.7.2024 Rishabh [Manish Kumar Nigam, J.] [Manoj Kumar Gupta, J.]
